title: Comic Strips
text:
Many people love comic strips. A comic strip is a short story with pictures. It usually has three or four boxes. The characters speak in bubbles above their heads.

Tom reads the comic strip every morning. His favorite character is a small dog named Max. Max is funny and always has a big smile. Tom likes to draw his own comic strips, too.

questions.text: How many boxes does a comic strip usually have?
What is the name of Tom's favorite character?
What can you infer about Tom?
options: He enjoys comic strips and likes to make them
He never reads in the morning

vocabulary.definition: the people or animals in a story
round shapes that show what a character says

paragraph_translations: Muitas pessoas adoram tiras de quadrinhos. Uma tira de quadrinhos é uma história curta com desenhos. Geralmente tem três ou quatro quadros. Os personagens falam em balões acima de suas cabeças.

Tom lê a tira de quadrinhos todas as manhãs. Seu personagem favorito é um cachorrinho chamado Max. Max é engraçado e sempre tem um sorriso grande. Tom também gosta de desenhar suas próprias tiras de quadrinhos.
